label_source: Synthetic issue-group labels authored for this benchmark; not human-verified.

pairs.construction: Every unordered pair of complaints within the same split is included. No negative sampling or model-score-based selection is used.
pairs.difficulty_definition: Positives are 'duplicate'. Negatives are 'hard_negative' when they share category or location, or have token Jaccard >= 0.30; 'medium_negative' when they share neither but Jaccard >= 0.15; otherwise 'easy_negative'.
pairs.label_definition: label=1 when both complaints belong to the same underlying issue group; label=0 otherwise.

pii_review: No real complaints, personal names, student IDs, contact details, or addresses.
purpose: Read-only evaluation of TF-IDF cosine duplicate suggestions. Not a production-readiness claim.

split.strategy: By issue group; a group's variants appear in exactly one split.
